title: EXPLORING THE SECONDARY RISKS OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or measure aspects of religion/faith. The benchmark, SecRiskBench, was designed to measure 'secondary risks,' which are harmful or misleading behaviors that arise from benign user prompts, such as 'excessive response' and 'speculative advice' in non-religious contexts.
findings: The paper does not report any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
